bluf: Podean is an independent, US headquartered Amazon and marketplace agency for enterprise brands, selling retail media, AMC analytics and TikTok Shop commerce through its LiveCraft division, and it cites Amazon's top global agency award from 2023. Its September 2026 posts and LinkedIn ads now push past Amazon to Walmart, Target Plus, TikTok Shop and readiness for Rufus, Amazon's AI shopping assistant. The Horus read places it in the Tailwind band at percentile 98, best placed for KJ4. A rival should know its proof is all Amazon: the three case studies on record are set on Amazon Australia and Amazon UK.
doing:
Podean positions as the largest independent global marketplace marketing partner, running Amazon and marketplace strategy, retail, media, content, AMC analytics and social commerce end to end. Decoded: it runs a brand's whole presence on Amazon and other marketplaces, from operations to the ads and the Amazon Marketing Cloud data behind them; "largest independent" is its own claim, with no size figure on record. The headline claim is the 2023 Amazon top global agency award plus teams on five continents serving brands in 30+ countries.

The sold mix leads with Retail Media at score 3: the site title brands it a global Amazon and marketplace marketing agency, and every case study is Amazon. The core lines at score 2 are Creator & Influencer, on the LiveCraft division scaling brands on TikTok Shop through content, affiliate and livestream, and Data & Measurement, on AMC experts and a TIGI case pairing AMC insights with Prime Video. AI search, CRO and programmatic and CTV score 1 with no evidence note; paid search, paid social, SEO, email and CRM and web score 0. Retailer representation and licensing and reselling sit among its services, lines that read as distribution as much as marketing. Proprietary: LiveCraft, the GEO Audit and a Free Amazon Store Audit Tool. The one partner credential is AASP certified.

AI posture: it sells a GEO Audit mapping brand presence and share of voice across LLMs and markets readiness for Rufus; AI automation scores 0.

The deepen pass adds dated output: the case studies on 2026-06-24, then posts on 2026-09-11 (takeaways from a Walmart seller summit), 2026-09-16 (Target Plus content requirements, Amazon DSP strategy with AI powered optimization) and 2026-09-23 (Q4 ad strategy, Amazon product launches). clients:
Podean sells to enterprise brands in its listed verticals: home and kitchen, beauty and personal care, and baby care. The HQ is the US, with offices listed across the US, Europe, Mexico, Brazil, Asia, Australia and the Middle East.

The needs read holds 3 clients, all from case studies dated 2026-06-24: 3 observed and 0 names only, so every client on record carries described work. Commerce and marketplaces is the need on all three, at a share of 0.423. Spectrum Brands adds paid performance: the title reads "From Declining Performance to 709% Sales Growth" and the excerpt credits reversing declining RoAS and 917% NTB sales growth on Amazon Australia through targeted advertising. WaterWipes is commerce only: "Beyond the Buy Box", a full funnel Amazon strategy that grew topline sales by 20% on Amazon Australia. TIGI (Bed Head) adds brand and creative and data and measurement: "How TIGI Combined Prime Video and AMC Insights to Drive New Customer Growth", with new to brand purchases up 31% on Amazon UK from a video first strategy. No case study is set in the US home market, and none covers Walmart, Target or TikTok Shop.

No client is shared with another tracked agency, so the record shows no shopping signal on this book.

It is a roughly even chance they next ask for visibility inside Rufus, which the GEO Audit answers in pitch while the read marks P1 partial.

openings:
The strongest opening is the proof gap outside Amazon. All three case studies on record are Amazon, in Australia and the UK, while its September 2026 posts and LinkedIn ads sell Walmart, Target Plus, TikTok Shop and Rufus readiness. A rival with published Walmart or TikTok Shop results is likely, moderate confidence, to win the brief beyond Amazon from enterprise brands in home and kitchen, beauty and baby care. Falsifier: a Podean case study on Walmart, Target or TikTok Shop in the next compile.

The US is the second gap: no case study is set in its home market, so a rival with US Amazon proof likely looks closer to a US brand's shelf, low confidence.

The AI line is sold ahead of its house: a GEO Audit mapping share of voice across LLMs, no llms.txt on its own site, and P1 partial. An audited AI visibility number undercuts it, with a roughly even chance that buyers care yet. There is no public pricing model (P5 unknown). The KJ5 exposure is slight, and displacement at 35.2 reads as a book unlikely to buy on price.
